data.gender_notes: Asya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Asiyah' meaning 'female servant of God'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-An'am, verse 135, where the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) are referred to as 'Asiyaatun Nubuwwah' or 'Mothers of the Prophet's Household'. The name Asya carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asya usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
